content:
jules: Tiny follow-up from the design review: action bar buttons in the dashboard are using filled primary for destructive actions. That feels wrong. Should be ghost/destructive. Also spacing between CTA and secondary is tight on narrow widths. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/review/action-bar-destructive.png
omar: which component token? is it using --button-variant-primary?
jules: yes, the toolbar override accidentally used `variant='primary'` for the delete action. propose we add an explicit `intent='destructive'` mapping in the button component to switch to ghost + accent color.
nina: we have a guideline doc in components/Buttons.md recommending ghost for destructive in toolbars. We should enforce via lint rule in eslint-plugin-design. Can add a rule that flags `variant='primary'` + `data-destructive` attribute.
ethan: also the spacing: small screens compress CTA and secondary to 6px gap. Token used is --space-xs. Should be --space-2 (8px). Behavior stems from the toolbar using `gap: var(--space-xs)` on .toolbar when collapsed. Change to `gap: var(--space-2)` and add a media query for compact view.
design-bot: reminder: Button tokens updated at 1780023400. Run `yarn build:components` after changes.
jules: accessibility: current destructive ghost still uses low-contrast red #E07A7A on hover. We need to ensure 3:1 contrast for non-text UI per WCAG. Suggest using a stronger red or adding a subtle border to increase contrast.
omar: propose using `var(--color-danger-600)` on hover and `--color-danger-300` for background in hover state. will check contrast ratios.
nina: lint rule PR sounds good. I'll draft it. Also switch tooltip copy for delete action to "Delete row" rather than just "Delete" for screen reader clarity.
ethan: plan: 1) update button component mapping for destructive intent in toolbars; 2) change toolbar gap token to --space-2 on compact; 3) adjust destructive hover color to danger-600; 4) add lint rule; 5) update docs. I'll break into two PRs: visual + a11y lint.
design-bot: CI: branch fix/toolbar-destructive built at 1780023500 (build #491). Visual previews: https://staging.redwood.dev/preview/491
jules: thanks team. small changes but important. Nina please ping me for the lint rule review. Omar please include before/after color swatches in PR.
nina: will do. ETA tomorrow morning for PRs.
design-bot: Note: changes touching button tokens may require a tokens publish: run `yarn tokens:publish` after merging.
jules: ok landing window next week after smoke tests. good catch, everyone.
